# Authoritative documentation rules

Apply these rules when modifying `docs/**`.

- `docs/` is the ERP source of truth.
- Read `docs/00-overview/02-governance.md` before changing architecture, standards, module specifications, or ADRs.
- Do not silently rewrite authoritative documentation to accommodate an implementation.
- If a proposed change alters an approved architectural decision, create/update the appropriate ADR and follow governance before treating the new decision as authoritative.
- Preserve traceability and cross-document consistency.
- Clearly distinguish approved/current material from proposed, deprecated, superseded, and archived material.
